failure_summary.description: Call sets included unrelated or wrongly selected operations, and one trajectory also omitted requested operations.
Both TED calls mapped a minimum-duration request to the maximum-duration field.

patch.reasoning: The skill already gives broad coverage and endpoint-selection guidance, so avoid duplicating it. Both trajectories inverted a one-sided duration threshold; make the mapping from comparison direction to minimum or maximum fields explicit.

edits.target: - Map every numeric range or threshold to the endpoint's corresponding filter fields, regardless of domain. When both bounds are available, set both; keep range bounds distinct from result counts and page sizes. For example, a requested length range maps to minimum- and maximum-length fields, not a per-page count. Do not omit a bound or repurpose a count field.
edits.content: - Map every numeric range or threshold to the endpoint's corresponding filter fields, regardless of domain. For one-sided thresholds, map larger/longer, above, or at-least requirements to a minimum/lower-bound field, and smaller/shorter, below, or at-most requirements to a maximum/upper-bound field; do not substitute the opposite bound just because it accepts a similar value. Preserve strict versus inclusive comparison when the schema supports it. When both bounds are available, set both; keep range bounds distinct from result counts and page sizes. For example, a requested length range maps to minimum- and maximum-length fields, not a per-page count. Do not omit a bound or repurpose a count field.
